name: Manganese nitrate
description: Manganese nitrate (CAS 10377-66-9 ) is an inorganic manganese salt used as a precursor and catalyst across several industrial processes. It delivers a soluble, reactive source of manganese where controlled deposition or oxidation chemistry is required. In textile dyeing and finishing, it serves as an oxidation catalyst for producing manganese-based colorants and for fixing certain dye systems onto fabric. The leather and paper industries use it as a component in tanning and bleaching processes. In these applications, controlled manganese release drives oxidative reactions. In agriculture, it functions as a micronutrient source in fertilizer formulations targeting manganese-deficient soils, particularly for crops sensitive to trace element imbalances. Water treatment operations apply it to support oxidative removal of iron and manganese from potable and process water streams. This ensures that water quality meets the necessary standards for both human consumption and industrial use. Manganese nitrate is commercially available as an aqueous solution, most commonly at 50% concentration, and in anhydrous or tetrahydrate solid form. This versatility allows it to be integrated into various liquid or solid manufacturing workflows. Technical grade is the standard offering across industrial supply channels. Purity specifications and solution concentration should be confirmed against application requirements, as catalyst and agricultural uses may carry different acceptance criteria.
